lucidfence_system_info.query: SELECT hostname, uuid, hardware_vendor, hardware_model, hardware_serial, computer_name, local_hostname FROM system_info;

lucidfence_os_version.query: SELECT name, version, major, minor, patch, build, platform, arch FROM os_version;

lucidfence_osquery_info.query: SELECT uuid, instance_id, version, config_hash, config_valid FROM osquery_info;

lucidfence_mounts_darwin.query: SELECT device, path, blocks_size, blocks, blocks_free, blocks_available FROM mounts WHERE path = '/';

lucidfence_mounts_linux.query: SELECT device, path, blocks_size, blocks, blocks_free, blocks_available FROM mounts WHERE path = '/';

lucidfence_disk_encryption_darwin.query: SELECT name, uuid, encrypted, type, encryption_status FROM disk_encryption;

lucidfence_disk_encryption_linux.query: SELECT name, uuid, encrypted, type, encryption_status FROM disk_encryption;

lucidfence_logical_drives_windows.query: SELECT device_id, free_space, size, file_system, boot_partition FROM logical_drives WHERE boot_partition = 1;

lucidfence_bitlocker_windows.query: SELECT device_id, drive_letter, conversion_status, protection_status, encryption_method, percentage_encrypted, lock_status FROM bitlocker_info;

lucidfence_battery_darwin.query: SELECT state, charging, charged, cycle_count, percent_remaining, health, condition FROM battery;

lucidfence_battery_windows.query: SELECT state, charging, charged, cycle_count, percent_remaining FROM battery;
